entities.name: Phage
entities.description: A Cabal figure commanding deathwurms who gives birth to Kuberr and takes control of the Cabal with Braids.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A druid and pit fighter who meditates in Krosa, later intervenes at Sanctum wielding Soul Reaper.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, whose identity Phage briefly held.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angel who takes control of Topos, serves Ixidor's last order and fights Phage.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Akroma's master, devoured by a deathwurm, who heals her inside it.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A Cabal leader who is brainwashed by Akroma and later summons a dementia monster to devour the Patriarch.

entities.name: The Patriarch
entities.description: The Cabal leader who enlists the unmen as assassins and is devoured by a dementia monster.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: A Cabal figure promised Phage by Kuberr, who plots her murder.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: The second numen, born to Phage at Aphetto.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: A centaur who co-leads Sanctum, is brainwashed by Akroma, then recovers and persuades Kamahl to intervene.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: A co-leader of Sanctum who is imprisoned and jumps to her death onto Phage and Akroma.

entities.name: Umbra
entities.description: The last unman, named by Akroma, who sacrifices himself to save Sash and Waistcoat.

entities.name: Sash and Waistcoat
entities.description: Two unmen who betrayed their creator and seek corporeal bodies.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: Ixidor's lost companion, whose corpse remains inside the deathwurm.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A goddess born from the combined souls and bodies of Phage, Akroma and Zagorka and the magic of Soul Reaper.

entities.name: Soul Reaper
entities.description: The weapon forged to kill Akroma, wielded by Kamahl.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: A numen who the glyphs claim will reincarnate as the city of Sanctum.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: A magnificent abandoned city settled by fugitives of the defeated army, covered in glyphs.

entities.name: Topos
entities.description: The battlefield and the place Akroma controls.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The faction led by the Patriarch, to which Phage and Braids belong.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: The city where Phage gives birth to Kuberr.

events.summary: The joint Cabal-Krosan army flees Phage's deathwurms at Topos; Akroma takes control of Topos after Ixidor is gone.
events.quote: Akroma takes control of Topos once she has learned that Ixidor is no longer.

events.summary: Fugitives from the defeated army settle an abandoned city under Zagorka and Stonebrow and name it Sanctum.
events.quote: Under the leadership of Zagorka and Stonebrow , they rebuild their lives and call the city Sanctum .

events.summary: Akroma finds the last unman and names him Umbra, then brainwashes the feeble Braids to learn Cabal secrets.
events.quote: Finally, she finds a feeble Braids and brainwashes her to be her follower.

events.summary: Phage sways Sanctum for the Cabal, and Akroma declares war on the Cabal and learns Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god Kuberr.
events.quote: to be the mother of the reincarnation of the Cabal god, Kuberr .

events.summary: The First realizes Phage is the only one able to resist him and plots to murder her, unaware she is pregnant with his child.
events.quote: unaware she is already pregnant with his child.

events.summary: The Patriarch captures the unmen and turns them into beetles to assassinate Akroma, with orders to kill Phage first.
Stonebrow tries to kill Akroma, is brainwashed to worship Ixidor, and then leads Topos in war on Sanctum when Akroma vanishes after the deathwurm.
events.quote: He becomes the angel's obedient servant.

events.summary: Inside the deathwurm, Akroma finds Ixidor, who heals her and shows her the way out.
events.quote: He heals his creation, though, and shows her the way out.

events.summary: Akroma and Phage battle until Stonebrow injures them both; Phage flees to give birth.
events.quote: Phage, wounded and weakened by pregnancy, flees to give birth.

events.summary: The Patriarch strips the unmen of their beetle bodies and banishes them; the glyphs overrun Sanctum and imprison Zagorka.
events.quote: They imprison Zagorka, while the unmen leave to wander.

events.summary: Phage gives birth to Kuberr, and Braids recovers her sanity and summons a dementia monster that devours the Patriarch; Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal.
events.quote: Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal in place of Kuberr.

events.summary: Akroma gives Sash and Waistcoat bodies to kill them, but Umbra sacrifices himself, closing the portal.
events.quote: Umbra jumps on them, making them go through him and closing the portal, dying in the process.

events.summary: Kuberr and Akroma's armies fight at Sanctum, which has become a twisted reflection of itself.
events.quote: The angel and the Cabalist fight bitterly and without mercy.

events.summary: Kamahl arrives with Soul Reaper and Zagorka jumps from her tower, crashing onto Phage and Akroma as Soul Reaper falls and kills them all; the goddess Karona is born.
events.quote: From the combination of their three souls and bodies, and the magic of Soul Reaper, the goddess Karona is born.

relations.note: She follows Ixidor's order to kill Phage.
